limits: All 26 installed Native Text controller cases pass across two disjoint selected invocations. The reopened-Task case performs three actual bounded C0 model Runs, two Human reopens and independent Plan verification, and retains the complete comment history and earlier document revision access.

The four SDK cases use pinned real managed OpenCode/runnerd binaries and deterministic HTTP with a local software Host. Their separate earlier source windows remain explicit. No paid provider or physical Host qualification is claimed.

Native12 conversation startup still reaches its test watchdog without a passing provider/reservation proof. Independent backend diagnostics now survive timeout. The temporal second journey, serial managed lifecycle and broader CI failures still need completion; this packet is not whole-suite or release acceptance.
No requirement or migration phase status is promoted. Failed/resource-stopped exploratory attempts remain private diagnostics.
